title: Protocol to stimulate and delineate alternative lengthening of telomeres in human U2OS cells
protocol: Induce the tethering of PML-IV to telomeres in U2OS cells expressing PYL1-TagRFP-TRF1 and ABI-EGFP-PML-IV.
Treat the cells with ABA to induce dimerization of PYL1 and ABI tagged proteins.
Analyze fluorescence of PML-IVGFP and TRF1GFP after treatment with DMSO or ABA for 18 hours.
Seed U2OS cells expressing TRF1RFP and PML-IVGFP in coverslips-containing 12-well plates with 1 mL culture medium at a confluency of 30%–50% (0.6 × 10^5 to 1 × 10^5 cells).
Culture U2OS cells for 24 h.
Treat U2OS cells with DMSO or ABA for 14 hours.
Analyze BLM by immunofluorescence (IF) and detect telomeres by fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH).
Label U2OS cells with EdU for 1 hour after treatment with DMSO or ABA for 18 hours.
Analyze EdU and telomere signals by IF and FISH.
To monitor the dynamics of telomere clustering, treat the cells with 200 μM ABA.
Add 1 μL of 200 mM ABA stock solution to 1 mL of cell media.
Incubate at 37°C for 4 hours.
Incubate at 37°C for 8 hours.
Incubate at 37°C for 12 hours.
Use DMSO as a control by treating cells with 1 μL of DMSO instead of ABA.
To visualize the enrichment of various proteins at telomeres, treat the cells with 1 μL of 200 mM ABA or DMSO.
Incubate for 14 hours.
To visualize telomeric DNA synthesis, treat the cells with 1 μL of 200 mM ABA or DMSO.
Incubate for 18 hours.
Add 2 μL of 10 mM EdU stock solution to 1 mL of cell media.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Cool the plate with cells on ice.
Rinse once with 1 mL ice-cold 1× phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Treat cells with 1 mL ice-cold pre-extraction buffer for 5 min on ice.
Rinse once with 1 mL ice-cold 1× PBS.
Remove the plate from ice.
Fix cells with 0.5 mL 3% paraformaldehyde for 15 min at 20°C–22°C.
Rinse the cells once with 1 mL 1× PBS.
Handle PFA under a fume hood due to its toxicity.
Permeabilize cells in 0.5 mL permeabilization buffer (1×PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100) for 5 min.
Rinse cells once with 1 mL 1×PBS.
Rinse cells with 0.5 mL PBS containing 3% bovine serum albumin (BSA).
Prepare click-iT reaction reagents freshly and use immediately.
Incubate coverslips with 25 μL reaction mixture on parafilm, cell-carrying side facing down at 20°C–22°C in the dark for 0.5 h.
Ensure to remove residual buffer from coverslips before incubation.
Incubate cells in freshly prepared blocking solution at 20°C–22°C for 1 h.
Dilute primary anti-BLM antibody (1:1000) or anti-biotin antibody (1:1000) in blocking solution.
Place parafilm in a flat container and add 25 μL diluted antibody solution on the parafilm for each coverslip.
Pick up the coverslips from 12-well plates, remove excess buffer by tapping them on filter paper.
Overlay the coverslips on the antibody solution with the cell-carrying side facing down.
Incubate at 20°C–22°C for 2 h or at 4°C for 12 h–24 h.
Incubate coverslips with primary antibody for 24 hours.
Move coverslips back into 12-well plates containing 1 mL PBST in each well.
Wash coverslips three times with 1 mL PBST for 5 minutes each under gentle agitation.
Incubate coverslips with anti-rabbit secondary antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor® 594 at 1:500 dilution in the blocking solution for 1 hour in the dark at 20°C–22°C.
Repeat steps for incubation with secondary antibody, moving coverslips back into 12-well plates after each step.
Wash coverslips three times with 1 mL PBST for 5 minutes each.
Fix cells again with 0.5 mL of 3% PFA at 20°C–22°C for 15 minutes.
Dehydrate cells in 0.5 mL of 70%, 85%, and 100% ethanol for 2 minutes each.
Take coverslips out of 12-well plates.
Place coverslips on the covers of 12-well plates to air dry completely.
Do not let coverslips lie flat during drying.
Prepare hybridizing solution (70% formamide, 2× SSC, 2 mg/mL BSA, 10% dextran sulfate) freshly for each use.
Mix 0.2 μL of 5 μM PNA telomere probe in 10 μL hybridization buffer to achieve a final concentration of 100 nM.
Vortex and centrifuge the mixture at 1000 g for 30 seconds.
Heat up the hybridizing solution containing PNA probe at 85°C for 2 minutes.
Prewarm coverslips and slides (75 × 25 mm) at 85°C on a metal heat block for 2 minutes.
Add 10 μL of the hybridization solution containing PNA probe to each coverslip.
Cover the coverslip with a prewarmed slide quickly and ensure the hybridization solution is evenly distributed.
Heat the slide with the coverslip on a metal heat block at 85°C for 10 minutes.
Place the slide in a closed container at 20°C–22°C for 2 h to 24 h for hybridization.
Immerse coverslips in wash solution 1 (2× SSC, 70% formamide).
Wash coverslips with 1 mL of wash solution 1 three times for 5 minutes each.
Wash coverslips with 1 mL of wash solution 2 (2× SSC, 0.1% Tween-20) three times for 5 minutes each.
Stain cells with 1 μg/mL DAPI for 5 minutes during the second wash cycle.
Prepare slides for microscope with 6 μL VECTASHIELD Antifade mounting medium.
Seal the slides with nail polish.
Capture images with a Nikon 90i microscope (objective: 60×; channels: DAPI, 488, 594).
Adjust exposure time of each channel to prevent signal saturation.
Use identical imaging parameters for samples being compared.
